Types of skirts every girl should know!
A-line. Fitted at the waist, it flares out like the letter A. Suits every body type.
Pencil. Slim and straight. Perfect for office.
Pleated. Soft folds that dance when you walk.
Wrap. It wraps around, and ties at the side.
Mini. Short, fun, and full of attitude.
Midi. It stops between the knee and the ankle. Classy, every day.
Maxi. Long, flowing, and so comfortable.
Tiered. Layer upon layer of boho fun.
Mermaid. Fitted, then flares at the bottom. Hello, party!
And our desi favourite... the lehenga skirt! Made for shaadi season.
So, which one are you wearing next? Tell me in the comments!
